violated_contract: A transient account-level destructive-operation fence (retention cleanup, legal-hold deletion gate) must surface as a bounded, retryable sync failure. Collapsing it into a generic app-level Failed outcome hides that the gate is temporary, so users hammer Retry while Cloud Tasks still has retry budget, and the true cause is unrecoverable from client telemetry.
canonical_prevention: Do not swallow DestructiveOperationInProgress on the sync reprocess path: re-raise it from merged conversation enrichment and from process_segment's generic except. Run _save_action_items inline when is_reprocess=True so the fence is observable. At the Cloud Tasks handler, map the fence to error_code destructive_operation_in_progress before failure_from_exception, keep it retryable (HTTP 500 + fenced_mark_job_queued_for_retry), and record that code in the sync failure-reason ledger.
